subject: Feasibility: HIPAA / GLBA / FERPA addenda + subprocessor disclosure
messages:
From: Alice Harrison <alice.harrison@northbridgehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@northbridgehealth.com, legal@northbridgehealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: HIPAA/GLBA/FERPA addenda feasibility + subprocessor list

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for taking this. We're evaluating Redwood for a couple of pilots (healthcare telemedicine workstreams and a separate K-12 deployment with Elm Unified). Before we proceed we need to understand:

- Whether Redwood can sign a standard BAA (HIPAA) and what that would cover (PHI categories, allowed uses).
- If a GLBA addendum is feasible for insurance/financial workflows and what contract language you'd need changed.
- FERPA: can Redwood contractually accept student data for the Elm pilot? Any special scoping requirements?
- Full current subprocessor list and whether there are any planned additions in the next 90 days.
- Data residency options and cross-border transfers (we have EU patient subsets).
- Retention and logging: what logs/extracts you provide for audits, and default retention windows.

I've attached our vendor questionnaire with required fields filled for the initial scoping (attachment: Northbridge_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf). Please let us know target timeline for a DPA/BAA redline and an initial list of subprocessors.

Best,
Alice
Alice Harrison
Sr. Contracts Manager, Northbridge Health
attachments: Northbridge_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Harrison <alice.harrison@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: HIPAA/GLBA/FERPA addenda feasibility + subprocessor list

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear summary and for the questionnaire. Quick response and next steps from our side: 

- We can execute a BAA in the standard form; I'll ask Legal (Vivek) to confirm any narrow carve-outs.
- GLBA addendum: likely feasible but will require a small set of targeted clause edits around definitions and allowed processing—Vivek will advise.
- FERPA: we support K-12 deployments with contractual controls, but we'll need to scope data segmentation and account-level controls for the Elm pilot.
- I'll share our current subprocessor disclosure and the latest DPA draft for redline.
- Proposed timeline: internal review this week, then share redline + subprocessor CSV by end of next week (target: 2026-01-22). Legal review and procurement signature typically 2–3 weeks after redline depending on redlines.

Attached for your convenience: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf (current DPA) and a BAA scoping worksheet (BAA_Scoping_Sheet.xlsx) that sketches how we map PHI categories.

I will coordinate a short cross-functional call (legal + security + procurement) if you want to walk through the redline. What times next week work for you?

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf; BAA_Scoping_Sheet.xlsx

Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: HIPAA/GLBA/FERPA addenda feasibility + subprocessor list

Hi Alice / team —

I wanted to follow up with a few technical clarifications from Platform/Engineering that will help scope the contractual language: 

1) Encryption and keys: we support TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest. We offer customer-managed keys (KMS) for Private deployments and can integrate with customer KMS/HSM for Dedicated/Private. For the Hosted API, we can discuss a contractual KMS option (BYOK) for enterprise contracts — please flag if Northbridge requires BYOK in production.

2) Data flows & PHI: please confirm which fields in your questionnaire are considered PHI for the pilot (e.g., full MRN, SSN, full DOB). That will determine whether we need additional pseudonymization or field-level exclusions at ingest.

3) Logs & retention: default request/response logs are retained for 30 days. We can extend retention for enterprise contracts; audit logs and token-level cost traces are available for SOC2 evidence. What retention window does procurement require?

4) Subprocessors: attached is our current disclosure (Subprocessor_Disclosure.csv). We need to confirm whether any subprocessors are disallowed by Northbridge procurement; if so, list them and we'll evaluate mitigation.

5) FERPA specifics for Elm: for student-data use, we typically require an admin-only tenant, strict role separation, and contractually limited data use — we can sketch required changes to DPA and acceptable technical controls once we have the Elm use case details.

I'll drop the subprocessor CSV here for your review. If helpful, we can do a short technical call to walk through the data flow diagram.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Platform Security, Redwood Inference
attachments: Subprocessor_Disclosure.csv

Hi Karthik / Laura / Vivek —

Thanks for the quick responses and the materials. A few clarifications from our side: 

- For Northbridge telemedicine pilot, PHI fields include MRN, partial SSN, and full DOB. We can provide a feed that pseudonymizes names if that reduces scope.
- Procurement requests a 3-year log retention (audit/syslog) for the initial contract; is that something Redwood can support in the hosted offering for an enterprise plan?
- For GLBA, the primary ask is an explicit clause around financial account information and acceptable use; procurement asks whether Redwood will accept GLBA-language redlines.
- For Elm Unified (FERPA), Mike Garcia is the district IT lead — he indicated the pilot would require a FERPA addendum and strict tenant isolation. Is that achievable without a separate physical deployment?

We prefer redlines via DocuSign or a shared Google Drive link (I've uploaded a filled questionnaire and a short use-case sketch): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Aexample/Privacy-Docs

Can you confirm whether subprocessor changes in the next 90 days are expected (Laura's CSV is helpful, but procurement wants a 90-day forecast).

Best,
Alice
attachments: (uploaded to Drive)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: HIPAA/GLBA/FERPA addenda feasibility + subprocessor list

Team — quick legal/ops summary and proposed next steps to share with Northbridge: 

Summary: 
- BAA (HIPAA): Redwood can execute a standard BAA. We'll map PHI categories in the BAA_Scoping_Sheet.xlsx and include the pseudonymization option as an implementation note.
- GLBA: Legal can accept GLBA-style redlines; expect a short negotiation around the "financial account information" definition and liability caps.
- FERPA: We can support FERPA-covered data for Elm Unified with contractual tenant isolation, admin-only access controls, and explicit permitted-use clauses. A separate physical deployment is not required if we provide logical/tenant isolation and strict role-based access controls documented in the addendum.
- Subprocessors: the attached Subprocessor_Disclosure.csv is current. No major additions planned in next 90 days other than an upgrade to our observability provider (will notify procurement if that changes).
- Data residency: we do not currently offer full EU-only hosting for the hosted multi-tenant plan; for EU-residency we recommend Redwood Private or Dedicated — we'll flag this as a limitation in the redline.
- Retention: default 30 days; enterprise contracts may extend to the requested 3 years but will trigger additional cost and operational safeguards (archival storage, access controls).

Next steps (proposed timeline):
1) Prepare a redline of Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf with BAA and GLBA addenda inserted + notes on FERPA scoping (target: 2026-01-22).
2) Share updated Subprocessor_Disclosure.csv and a short cover note on any planned changes (by 2026-01-19).
3) Schedule a three-way call (Legal + Procurement + Platform Security) with Northbridge + Elm pilot lead to walk the redline (week of 2026-01-25).
4) Post-call: finalize redlines and prepare DocuSign envelope for signature (estimate 2–3 weeks to signature depending on redlines).

Action items for Karthik / Sales: please propose 2 time slots for the initial call next week (Jan 25–29) and attach the redline when ready. Also confirm whether Northbridge prefers a formal SOC2 + evidence package prior to signature or can accept SOC2 in-flight with a short security attestation.

I'll draft the redline and start the DPA updates — Laura please confirm the BYOK ask (hosted vs private). Jasmine, can you prepare a short one-page diagram of the proposed data flows for the call?

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
